title: Resident bicycle parking: 0.5 spaces per dwelling (Table 2.3a)
text: Bicycle parking is provided on site and in accordance with Table 2.3b and Figure 2.3a. Table 2.3a Bicycle parking¹, Resident: 0.5 space per dwelling (Location A and Location B). ¹Calculations of parking ratios shall be rounded to the nearest whole number, with fractions of 0.5 or greater rounded up (for example, 1.4 bays is rounded to 1 bay and 1.5 bays is rounded to 2 bays).

evaluator.label: 0.5 resident spaces per dwelling, rounded to the nearest whole number with 0.5 rounded up

replaces.note: resident 0.5 per dwelling unchanged; rounding up -> nearest whole number

verified.note: Clause cites 'Table 2.3b', which does not exist; bicycle rates read from Table 2.3a (p19-20).

notes: new: no Chapter 3 equivalent. The clause cites 'Table 2.3b', which does not exist in this chapter; the bicycle rates are in Table 2.3a (register C4P1-046), read as such.
